abstract: An explicit projective inverse reconstructs one unknown outgoing joint semi-Markov transition/waiting-time row from complete one-start occupation curves and preserves every affine response dimension. Continuous reset-rate stationary occupations identify the row, but finitely many rates never do so nonparametrically.
scientific_integrity: Only algebraic proof, Laplace uniqueness and deterministic computational consistency checks are claimed; no experimental data, independent replication or novel sufficient-affine direction is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires exact known background, no self jumps, fresh-entry initialization and complete noiseless response curves. Unrestricted finite-sample or noisy inference and inverse-Laplace stability are not established; an equivalent in older inverse renewal literature remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Single-start tomography and projective response rigidity in semi-Markov networks
